hotspot.k: Giveback Ventures · capital and on-chain treasury hall
hotspot.p: Giveback powers the giving here: a micro-economy of giving, where business activity, purchases and community participation automatically become giving, in any form, verified on chain. The hall follows capital from a corporate bank account to verified giving, one station at a time, beside the ledger wall. Take the wide stair on the north side up to the terrace and the Riverside Management Group suite, where Will Deitrick explains how capital works in the Genesis ecosystem.

entry.k: Walk in · the capital flow and the ledger wall
entry.p: Step inside to follow the capital flow from left to right and watch the ledger wall at the back of the hall. Riverside Management Group is upstairs: the stair is outside on the north side.

ledger.title: THE GIVEBACK LEDGER
ledger.sub: Every gift recorded on chain · Solana

hotspot.p: A demo of the Giveback Ledger. Every transaction through the protocol leaves a public record on Solana: its signature, its route and its confirmation. Anyone can check the record and no one can quietly edit it, which is what makes giving permanent and verifiable.

Each station is one step capital takes, and each step leaves a record.

terrace.p: The terrace looks west over Compass Plaza and Main Street, and south down Sculpture Avenue to the Genesis Ring. The Riverside Management Group suite opens onto it.

will.name: Will Deitrick
greet: The Ring looks best from up here.

talk.t: Welcome to Riverside Management Group. I'm Will Deitrick, Managing Director. Giveback Ventures and Riverside Management Group have signed an agreement to work together, and I'm glad to explain how the pieces fit. Where would you like to start?
o: What is real world asset tokenization?

talk.t: Downstairs in the GBANK hall you can follow it end to end. Funds start in a corporate bank account, cross onto the blockchain through the Altitude bridge, and sit in a Squads multisig treasury, where several signers must approve every movement. The Giveback protocol then routes each transaction and records it on chain, and giving reaches nonprofits and causes vetted in house by Giveback's own compliance team.
o: What is real world asset tokenization?

talk.t: Tokenization means recording ownership of a real asset, such as land, as digital tokens on a blockchain, so the record is transparent and transfers can settle quickly. Selling interests in a real asset to investors is generally a securities offering, so it happens only through licensed professionals and formal documents, never in a game.

Riverside Management Group is a merchant banking boutique founded in 1996. We advise companies on corporate finance, private equity and venture capital across industrial, technology, hospitality and healthcare businesses. Riverside Management Group brings decades of merchant banking and capital markets experience to our work with Giveback Ventures.

BCW Securities is Riverside Management Group's affiliated broker-dealer, a FINRA member. A registered broker-dealer is what allows a firm to place securities with investors, and it works under the rules for private placements: the documents, the diligence and who may take part. That work happens with us directly, never in here.

$GBACK is a utility token: access, memberships and the rails that make giving automatic. It is not an investment, and Giveback Ventures is its largest holder, not its issuer. Keep it in a separate lane from any securities offering, which would have its own documents and its own licensed process.

If you are interested in investing, please speak with Riverside Management Group directly at rmginvestments.com, and we will take you through it properly and in the right setting. I can't take an investment or give personal advice in here.

On chain means the record lives on a public blockchain, here Solana, where anyone can check it and no one can quietly change it. The ledger wall downstairs shows what that stream looks like: signatures, routes and confirmations.

My pleasure. Enjoy the terrace on your way out; the view down to the Ring is the best in The Expanse. For anything about investing, reach Riverside Management Group at rmginvestments.com. Nothing here is an offer to sell securities or investment advice.

paul.name: Paul Mazzapica
paul.about: A fintech corporation that matches high-net-worth retirees with wealth managers. Servicing Fisher Investments, Edelman Financial Engines, Empower, and more.
greet: Good to see you. Ask me anything.

talk.t: Welcome. I'm Paul Mazzapica, co-founder and president of FinanceAdvisors.com. We are a fintech company that matches high-net-worth retirees with wealth managers, servicing Fisher Investments, Edelman Financial Engines, Empower and more. What can I tell you?
o: How do I get in touch?

talk.t: You tell us a little about your situation and what you are looking for, and we introduce you to independent wealth managers who may be a good fit. You meet them, ask your questions, and decide for yourself whether to work with any of them.
o: How do I get in touch?

talk.t: No. FinanceAdvisors.com does not give investment advice or recommend investments. We make introductions; any advice comes from the licensed, independent wealth manager you choose to work with.

FinanceAdvisors.com is one of the industry partners here at Solport, in the Stellar Aviation FBO. To see how capital works in the Genesis ecosystem, visit GBANK beside Compass Plaza, where Will Deitrick of Riverside Management Group can walk you through it.
o: How do I get in touch?

talk.t: You can reach me at paul@financeadvisors.com, or visit financeadvisors.com to get started.
Thanks for stopping by, and enjoy Genesis. Nothing here is an offer to sell securities or investment advice.
